test_status: Same 12 previously viewed sessions as v0.1; retrospective matched comparison, not unseen holdout

model.region_network: 17-32-16-1 sigmoid; early BITX hourly pretrain then 5m finetune
model.return_network: 35-32-16-3 regression; all eligible BITX training states, 5/15/30m returns

training_labels: All eligible historical state/action returns, not just prior selected trades; learned only on training period
score_quantile_source: training-state predicted max net return, never validation/test outcomes
window_policy: Each of three windows enters at first completed state reaching fixed training score threshold. If none, enter at the deadline as explicitly marked forced exploration; no future best-time selection.
execution: next 5m open; long-only whole shares; planned 5/15/30m exit at bar close; no daily loss stop
settlement: No same-day sale-proceeds reuse; settle next regular trading day; no reset within segment
selection: Select highest validation mean daily PnL only among candidates meeting both activity gates. If none, declare activity failure; diagnostic replay picks highest trade count without qualification.
success_gate: activity passes AND mean daily net>=200 AND all test days>=200 AND stress total net>0. Report daily-target rate regardless.
baselines: Fixed schedule same 3 deadlines/capital/cost, separately 5/15/30m; v0.1 frozen result on same dates
recognition_metrics: First-touch per unique zone primary; repeated touches secondary, not independent new zones. Same-zone outcomes purged within split.
